concept: EBS: encryption by default at the Region level
tests: How to guarantee all new EBS volumes are encrypted without relying on users.
expected: Enable EBS encryption by default in the EC2 settings of each Region — new volumes and snapshots are encrypted automatically. Triggers: "always encrypted", "without relying on users".
why_not: Manual encryption after creation — errors and a plaintext window; an SCP denying RunInstances blocks all launches; S3 default encryption doesn't apply to EBS.
